_note: Meta-mode readiness rubric. Same criterion ids as readiness.v1 but reweighted to emphasise failure handling and observability — the two readiness dimensions most likely to mask Agent #8 corruption.

criteria.label: Functional correctness (meta)
criteria.description: Agent #8 produces correct evaluations on representative inputs.

criteria.label: Failure mode handling (meta)
criteria.description: Agent #8 handles malformed targets, missing rubrics, evaluator throws — without data corruption.

criteria.label: Performance under realistic load (meta)
criteria.description: Audit latency under expected load. Lower weight — meta runs are not on hot path.

criteria.label: Observability sufficient for ops (meta)
criteria.description: Meta-audit emits to #10 Monitor with enough detail to diagnose a disputed verdict.

criteria.label: Documentation present and accurate (meta)
criteria.description: Meta-audit operating procedure published. Disagreement-protocol rules visible.
